visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair, wearing a gray T-shirt, lies on a gray patterned floor mat inside a well-lit home. A Shiba Inu dog sits beside him on the left. The background features a wooden cabinet and a glass balcony door with natural light. A logo is at the top left. (2) The man extends his right hand towards the dog. The Shiba Inu responds by lifting its right front paw and placing it onto the man's palm. The man then pulls the dog's paw towards his face and sniffs it while looking directly at the dog. (3) The man recoils with an exaggerated expression of disgust, opening his mouth wide as if shouting. A small white ghost icon appears above his head. He points at the dog's paw while talking animatedly. (4) The dog stands up slightly and swipes its right front paw at the man's face multiple times in rapid succession. Red vein-like anger symbols appear over the dog's head. The man covers his face with his hand while laughing and tilting away. (5) The dog settles back down and licks its snout while the man remains lying on the mat, his face still partially covered by his hand.
